prompt_md: Five friends each mail a holiday card to every one of the other four. How many cards are mailed in total?
prompt_short: Five friends each mail a card to each of the others. How many cards?
hint_md: A card from Ana to Ben is not the same card as one from Ben to Ana.
explain_intuition_md: This isn't a handshake count: every pair swaps two cards, one each way. Five people each send four cards, which makes 20.
